title: Powers generate the same separable field extension
statement: Let $F\subseteq L$ be fields [def-pc-field-extension] of characteristic $p>0$, with $L/F$ separable algebraic [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]. For every integer $n\geq0$, write $L^{p^n}=\{x^{p^n}:x\in L\}$, a subfield of $L$. Then $L=F(L^{p^n})$, where $F(L^{p^n})$ is the smallest subfield of $L$ containing $F$ and $L^{p^n}$. No finiteness assumption on $L/F$ is required.

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line: take S = Set.univ in the separable extension L/F, q = p and n the specified integer. Adjoining all elements is top, and the image of the p^n power map is precisely the displayed subfield.
